proposal_basis.VLM_c: The only qualified path in the completed broad-mask discovery,70/80; explicitly selected using known previous outcomes.
proposal_basis.AE_layers: Nested two/four/six skips from the historical global low first5-command NMSE ranking; single-layer proxy only, not assumed composable or task-specific.
proposal_basis.hybrid: Three VLM skips from the old Jac mask plus three low global-error AE skips; no measured task preference assumed.

calibration.required: Actual native no-AE-bypass raw/decoded D10 and D2 parity on four bank inputs; direct AE visits and actualNFE; all four Full trajectories must bridge preserved Full actions/outcomes before any quality-reference reuse.
calibration.profile: All six fixed configurations measured on the original four-suite input bank,6 warmup and12 measured rounds each; descriptive native policy cost only

discovery.reference_scope: Prior original records/manifests remain unchanged and retain source identities. This is exploratory reuse of known discovery controls, never a new160-case replication. Only reuse after a source/numerical/physical-input bridge passes.
discovery.pair_eligibility: Both overall>=.75 and >=Full-.15; each median completed-service native cost ratio>=1.15; pair measured mean-cycle cost within10%; opposite distinct-suite gaps>=.10, >=2 positive tasks and every task leave-one-out positive.
discovery.ranking: Maximum minimum directional gap, sum gaps, minimum overall successes, then lexical path/suite ids; freeze one pair only after all320 new and160 preserved cases accepted

confirmation.conditions: Full and exactly two frozen paths
confirmation.primary: One-sided exact ten-task sign-flip including ties, Holm2 across exactly two frozen directions
confirmation.verdict: Both frozen directions positive; primary Holm2 p<.05; whole-task bootstrap lower>0; every task leave-one-out positive; both paths>=.75 and>=Full-.15; measured pair cost within10% and each ratio>=1.15

fixed_science.VLM_compensation: Own-path residual extrapolation; empty VLM mask still has periodic timestamps

cost_warning: VLM/AE layer counts do not represent equal computation. Pair matching uses measured completed-policy cost, not layer counts or FLOP estimates.
limits: Suite-conditioned effects only; no universal semantic-category or same-task phase claim, no exclusive-GPU timing guarantee; many exploratory branches do not provide a study-wide5% error guarantee.
no_candidate: Do not launch confirmation or weaken gates; preserve this bounded result and continue the overall goal separately
